summary: Military aircraft conducting high energy manoeuvres up to 5,000 ft within 5 nautical miles of Bowbank, flying at up to 450 knots.
text:
AIR EXER. 1 MIL ACFT WILL CONDUCT HIGH ENERGY MANOEUVRES IN
SUPPORT OF GROUND TROOPS WI 5NM RADIUS OF 543633N 0020545W
(BOWBANK). ACFT MAY OPERATE AT SPEEDS OF UP TO 450 KNOTS IAS AND
MAY BE UNABLE TO COMPLY WITH RAC. FOR FURTHER INFO AIC Y007/2023
REFERS. OPS CTC ON CH127.185 OR FREQUENCY 277.350MHZ FOR INFO
07517 258611. AR-2026-10146/01.
